author: spidey simp
description: A collection of custom server administration and bot maintenance utilities, including Question of the Day scheduling, project tracking, feature suggestions, command-tree maintenance, and server activity audits.
install_msg: SpideyServerTools contains utilities developed for spidey simp's own bot and server environment and is not intended for general installation.
short: Custom server and bot administration tools
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and usernames associated with submitted questions and project activity, as well as server configuration, channel IDs, message IDs, project tracking data, and feature suggestions.
